papers.name: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
papers.takeaway: Separate persistent parameter/scaffold updates from transient working memory; audit critic, attribution, transfer and resource budgets.
papers.boundary: A taxonomy and evaluation framework, not an RMOT algorithm or guarantee.

papers.name: TTRL: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
papers.takeaway: On-policy unlabeled adaptation using repeated-sampling majority-vote reward.
papers.boundary: Binary RMOT majority errors invert all binary correctness rewards. Numerical-answer diversity arguments do not establish reward reliability for Yes/No or multi-referent tracking.

papers.name: Agent0
papers.takeaway: Alternate learned curriculum and solver; filter difficulty, retain diversity; ADPO reduces noisy-label advantage while relaxing exploration clipping.
papers.boundary: Solver targets are majority pseudo-labels. Tool-call count rewards are not tool usefulness. No independent RMOT correctness signal follows from the framework.

papers.name: Agent0-VL
papers.takeaway: Tool-grounded solver/verifier/repair roles and selective correction.
papers.boundary: Paper includes SFT initialization. Inspected default reward code reads a ground_truth field for math outcome scoring; this field's provenance is not verified here, so this is not a claim of paper leakage. Tool success is not visual semantic correctness.

papers.name: Self-Evolving Visual Agent via Margin Reward (Marvo)
papers.takeaway: Train a challenger on tool-assisted minus direct solver success, targeting actual tool benefit rather than confusion or tool count.
papers.boundary: Reference is the challenger-generated MCQ label, not independently established image truth. Keep the original RMOT query fixed; transfer the value-of-observation idea, not self-authored answers or equilibrium guarantees.

papers.name: SelectTTRL
papers.takeaway: Select valuable unlabeled target problems before expensive rollouts.
papers.boundary: Specific correctness direction uses an independent QA dataset's answer contrasts. No target GT is used here to learn that direction; selection percentiles are not copied or tuned on RMOT HOTA.

three_candidate_contributions.human_vision: Search broadly, contrast ambiguous objects, recheck only if another look can help.
three_candidate_contributions.classical_idea: Value of information and experimental design; marginal gain from a controlled observation, not entropy alone.
three_candidate_contributions.RSI: Observer choices train the solver; fresh paid whole-group held-out teacher-risk progress trains the observer.
three_candidate_contributions.must_test: Learned versus frozen observer with same question quota; reverse fixed replay; complete candidate action metadata without free unseen teacher answers.

three_candidate_contributions.human_vision: Compare competing people in a common scene and moment.
three_candidate_contributions.classical_idea: Conditional likelihood removes shared nuisance only under an explicit comparable-context assumption.
three_candidate_contributions.RSI: The solver identifies unresolved candidate contrasts for the observer; newly paid evidence updates relative features.
three_candidate_contributions.must_test: Same-time/effective-view controlled contrasts versus existing cross-time pairs; adequate ordinary point/joint/logit KD with all the same evidence; two CountMatched directions.

three_candidate_contributions.human_vision: Retain who an object is, revise a temporary action or location only with evidence.
three_candidate_contributions.classical_idea: Hierarchical latent variables, identifiability and partial pooling; regularize unsupported dynamic residuals without hard-wiring temporal constancy.
three_candidate_contributions.RSI: Solver residual ambiguity requests targeted observations; external teacher evidence governs whether state changes are consolidated.
three_candidate_contributions.must_test: Identity-only retraining versus full state with and without controlled repeated observations; preserve true time-varying RMOT membership and association; same-capacity/compute controls.

current_evidence_limits: All three module descriptions remain hypotheses until all-six quality and ablation evidence; current prefix teacher risks are not RMOT labels.
Paid-pair audit and state-probe audit use first min(10,N) completed setting-videos; they do not peek current studies' HOTA.
Existing 24 two-time normal-teacher pairs have zero half-threshold flips; no evidence here for indiscriminate temporal rechecking.
Keep four immutable registered live studies. No extra large quality matrix, teacher recollection or seed grid was launched for this literature steering.
